description: This file implements functions for parsing, managing, and applying refspecs in a Git-like version control system, including handling patterns, negative refspecs, and matching logic.

methods.name: parse_refspec
methods.description: Parses a refspec string into a refspec_item structure, handling patterns, negations, and validation.

methods.name: refspec_item_init
methods.description: Initializes a refspec_item with a refspec string and fetch flag, calling parse_refspec.

methods.name: refspec_item_init_fetch
methods.description: Initializes a refspec_item for fetching.

methods.name: refspec_item_init_push
methods.description: Initializes a refspec_item for pushing.

methods.name: refspec_item_clear
methods.description: Clears and frees resources associated with a refspec_item.

methods.name: refspec_init_fetch
methods.description: Initializes a refspec structure for fetch operations.

methods.name: refspec_init_push
methods.description: Initializes a refspec structure for push operations.

methods.name: refspec_append
methods.description: Appends a refspec string to a refspec structure, initializing a refspec_item.

methods.name: refspec_appendf
methods.description: Appends a formatted refspec string to a refspec structure.

methods.name: refspec_appendn
methods.description: Appends multiple refspec strings to a refspec structure.

methods.name: refspec_clear
methods.description: Clears all refspec items from a refspec structure.

methods.name: valid_fetch_refspec
methods.description: Validates a fetch refspec string.

methods.name: refspec_ref_prefixes
methods.description: Extracts reference prefixes from a refspec, considering patterns and negations.

methods.name: match_refname_with_pattern
methods.description: Matches a refname against a pattern with wildcard '*' and optionally generates a replacement string.

methods.name: refspec_match
methods.description: Checks if a refspec matches a given refname.

methods.name: refname_matches_negative_refspec_item
methods.description: Checks if a refname matches any negative refspec item in a refspec structure.

methods.name: refspec_find_negative_match
methods.description: Determines if a refname matches any negative refspecs, considering patterns and special matching.

methods.name: refspec_find_all_matches
methods.description: Finds all refnames matching a query refspec, considering negative refspecs.

methods.name: refspec_find_match
methods.description: Finds a single match for a refspec query, returning success or failure.

methods.name: apply_negative_refspecs
methods.description: Removes refs from a ref list that match negative refspecs.

methods.name: apply_refspecs
methods.description: Applies refspecs to a refname to determine the destination ref name.
